notes.title: I Hate Business – Free To Play Time
notes.notes:
After a few years of trying to produce video games for fun and finances it turns out I am not a business minded person and building games with the end goal of profit removes all the fun out of designing and making games for me.

Because of this I will be making my games free to play from now on and will be moving back to doing this for fun and enjoyment. I do apologise to all those who have purchased  and supported me in developing my games over the past few years and I hope you will accept my reasoning and a few special in-game items as compensation. Your support has been greatly appreciated!

I will be making the change on the 30th June and this change will be made for both my current titles Dark Dealings and Bang Bang Land.  

The journey is far from over and its about to become enjoyable again! 

A number of unique in-game items will also be made available for all those who have supported this endeavour over my next few game updates.
